answer: A real identity leaves footprints in boring places. Proof of property tax payment via municipal assessment roll is a boring footprint: payments the municipality has receipted every year. The gale of the footprint is its dullness - nobody fakes a record this uninteresting unless it is real. One fake footprint is a printer and an afternoon; a hundred need a hundred dull lives, and the ivory of each life is the detail: the small fees, the misspellings, the mistakes. The plume that catches the farm is the mistake that is missing - a perfect file is the most suspicious.
